name: Jeddah Corniche Circuit
summary: The fastest street circuit in F1: 27 corners, walls everywhere and an average speed over 250 km/h.
character: Mostly flat-out sweeping corners between concrete walls along the Red Sea. Many corners are blind, so drivers can't always see what's ahead. Safety cars and red flags are common.

corners.name: Turn 13
corners.note: A banked hairpin, tilted about 12 degrees.

corners.name: Turns 22-24
corners.note: Fast sweeping corners near the end of the lap, walls on both sides.

moments.title: Hamilton vs Verstappen, round 21
moments.body: Two red flags, an argument over the restart order and Max Verstappen braking in front of Lewis Hamilton, who ran into the back of him. Hamilton won, and they went to the final race level on points.

history.body: First race, on a track built in under a year.
A missile attack hit an oil depot near the track during practice. The race went ahead.
The Saudi Arabian Grand Prix was cancelled.
